artContract.monkeys: art.monkeys[id][pose] lists of SVG frames; drawn poses idle/aim/fly/land/run/jump/dizzy have 10 frames, warm-only poses bonk/victory have 6; renderer cycles frames.
artContract.bandits: art.bandits[id][pose] lists of 10 SVG frames; poses idle/peek/flee/hide/bonked/taunt/dazed; renderer cycles frames.
artContract.rivals: art.rivals[id][pose] single SVG strings; poses confident/aiming/taunting/shocked; rival list avatars, match screens, tournament leaderboard.
artContract.worlds: art.worlds[world_N] lists of 6 SVG layers, index 0 farthest/faintest to 5 nearest/densest; parallax silhouette bands anchored to the ground line.
artContract.props: art.props[key] lists of 4 SVG frames. Block faces: frame by damage state (0 pristine to 3 heavily cracked); steel_block frames are gleam phases (never damaged). boom_barrel: fuse/wobble phases. *_spot, thorn_bramble, sticky_mud, tall_ledge, one_way_gate, moving_platform, hidey_tunnel, bouncy_mushroom, wind_gust, bonus_banana, decoy_banana, trophy_*, star_medal: ambient animation phases cycled slowly. slingshot_frame: band pull phases 0..3 picked by pull amount.
artContract.particles: art.particles[key] lists of 4 SVG frames; burst sequences played in order on the matching event (launch_dust, wood_splinter, glass_shard, stone_chunk, explosion_cloud, bonk_starburst, dash_ring_pulse, combo_flame, banana_sparkle, confetti_ribbon, dizzy_halo, mud_splash, wind_swirl, mushroom_spore).

monkeys.name: Rocco
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: Rocco dives steeply toward the structure below, hitting much harder on impact.
monkeys.quote: Stand back! Rocco smash fort into toothpicks!

monkeys.name: Zippy
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: a burst of speed along the current heading, punching through walls and stretching the arc.
monkeys.quote: Blink and you missed me! Where are the bananas?!

monkeys.name: Poppy
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: Poppy splits into three smaller monkeys fanning out — the center keeps flying, two flank at angles.
monkeys.quote: One Poppy in, three Poppies out — surprise!

monkeys.name: Bongo
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: Bongo loops back in a wide arc to strike the rear of the fort.
monkeys.quote: Step right up, folks! Watch Bongo come right back around!

monkeys.name: Gordo
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: Gordo drops a heavy boulder straight down onto the fort below and keeps flying.
monkeys.quote: Feel the ground shake! Something heavy is coming down!

monkeys.name: Lulu
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight for 3 seconds of level flight before gravity takes over again.
monkeys.quote: Up, up, and over the wall! No perch is too high!

monkeys.name: Nitro
monkeys.abilityDesc: Tap in flight: Nitro detonates mid-flight, blasting blocks and bandits around him. The blast ends his flight.
monkeys.quote: Light the fuse — Nitro clears the way!

bandits.name: Slink
bandits.desc: Masked raccoon-bandit, tucked into the fort.
bandits.counter: Bring the fort down on him — a falling block or a direct hit does it.

bandits.name: Hider
bandits.desc: Timid bush-lemur bandit, sheltering inside a breakable spot.
bandits.counter: Smash his shelter open, or drop the structure around him.

bandits.name: Climber
bandits.desc: Agile gecko-critter bandit, perched high on a ledge.
bandits.counter: Use Lulu's Leaf Glide, bounce off mushrooms, or aim a direct high-arc launch.

bandits.name: Dasher
bandits.desc: Hyperactive hare-bandit, out in the open.
bandits.counter: A direct hit or a falling block takes him down.

bandits.name: Shielder
bandits.desc: Armadillo-bandit carrying a heavy pot-lid shield — a cover prop in front of him.
bandits.counter: Break through the shield cover from above, or bring the wall down around him.

bandits.name: Digger
bandits.desc: Mole-bandit, tucked low in the fort.
bandits.counter: Collapse the structure over him or land a direct hit.

bandits.name: Mimic
bandits.desc: Chameleon-bandit disguised as a rock or crate — it looks like an ordinary block until something hits it.
bandits.counter: Watch for the tell — it trembles slightly and its shifty eyes give it away. The first hit reveals it; the second destroys it.

bandits.name: Big Boss
bandits.desc: Chief of the Banana Bandits! The boss of the fort — it takes two solid hits to bring him down.
bandits.counter: Land two solid hits — the first pops its crown, the second finishes it.

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: The Banana Bandits cleaned out the Great Banana Tree! Every single bunch is gone!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Look! Those masked critters built bamboo forts across Jungle Jamboree!

introLines.speaker: Baron Brambletail
introLines.text: Heh-heh! Catch us if you can, slowpokes! These forts will stand forever!

introLines.speaker: Poppy
introLines.text: Load the slingshot! Smash their cover, grab every banana, and bring the fort down!

outroLines.speaker: Baron Brambletail
outroLines.text: My crown! My fort! Retreat to Sunny Shores with the main banana barges!

outroLines.speaker: Rocco
outroLines.text: One boss bonked, four worlds to go! Grab those bananas and move out!

introLines.speaker: Bongo
introLines.text: They stacked our golden bananas inside driftwood towers all along the beach!

introLines.speaker: Lulu
introLines.text: Watch out for the sea breezes and driftwood towers — time your arcs carefully!

introLines.speaker: Captain Barnacle Whiskers
introLines.text: Yarrr! My Shielders and Climbers have every perch locked down tight!

introLines.speaker: Gordo
introLines.text: Nothing a well-placed Boulder Drop can't rearrange! Fire away!

outroLines.speaker: Captain Barnacle Whiskers
outroLines.text: Shiver me coconut shells! They bounced right over my shield wall!

outroLines.speaker: Lulu
outroLines.text: The trail leads up into the Misty Mountains! Keep the slingshot warm!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Brrr! The wind gusts up here push you mid-flight AND off your arc!

introLines.speaker: Poppy
introLines.text: And look at those stone ledges carved into the cliffside!

introLines.speaker: Duke Gale-Claw
introLines.text: Our Diggers and Dashers will run circles around you in the mountain mist!

introLines.speaker: Bongo
introLines.text: Aim over the ridge and let my Comeback Curve arc strike from behind!

outroLines.speaker: Duke Gale-Claw
outroLines.text: Impossible! How did you time the moving platforms in this gale?!

outroLines.speaker: Gordo
outroLines.text: They fled underground into the Midnight Caves! Grab a torch and follow me!

introLines.speaker: Lulu
introLines.text: Everything glows down here... wait, did that crystal rock just blink at me?!

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: Mimic Bandits! And fake props too! Look closely before you launch!

introLines.speaker: Count Shadow-Snout
introLines.text: In the crystal dark, every crate could be a Bandit, and every banana a trap!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Watch for trembling props and shifty eyes — let's light up this cavern!

outroLines.speaker: Count Shadow-Snout
outroLines.text: Hisss! My finest disguises sawed right through! Supreme Chief Magma-Tail awaits you!

outroLines.speaker: Poppy
outroLines.text: The final banana vault is inside Volcano Vale! This is it, crew!

introLines.speaker: Gordo
introLines.text: The Great Banana Hoard is right behind that steel-and-stone obsidian citadel!

introLines.speaker: Emperor Magma-Tail
introLines.text: Welcome to Volcano Vale, monkeys! Every Bandit in my legion is on high alert!

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: Boom barrels, bouncy shrooms, moving bridges, steel plates — give it everything we've got!

introLines.speaker: Lulu
introLines.text: For the Great Banana Hoard! Launch and BONK!

outroLines.speaker: Emperor Magma-Tail
outroLines.text: Noooo! My double-plated crown! Take your bananas, you relentless primates!

outroLines.speaker: Rocco
outroLines.text: THE GREAT BANANA HOARD IS OURS AGAIN! Victory dance, everyone!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Scouts found a SECOND hoard! The bandits stashed a whole ice vault of bananas beyond the volcano!

introLines.speaker: Marquis Frostwhisker
introLines.text: Chill out, monkeys. My glacier forts are frozen solid — your little slingshot will just bounce off!

introLines.speaker: Lulu
introLines.text: Ice, wind, and tall frozen ledges. Fly high, arc true, and bonk fast before the cold bites!

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: Frozen or not, a fort is a fort. Rocco smashes! For the second hoard!

outroLines.speaker: Marquis Frostwhisker
outroLines.text: My ice crown… cracked! Fall back to Cactus Canyon — the Sultan will freeze you out for good!

outroLines.speaker: Poppy
outroLines.text: One vault thawed, four to go! Somebody pack sunscreen — the desert is next!

introLines.speaker: Bongo
introLines.text: Mesa forts, dust devils, and cactus spikes everywhere! The Sultan built his vaults into the cliffs!

introLines.speaker: Sultan Sandclaw
introLines.text: Welcome to my canyon, little monkeys. The wind here blows a body sideways — aim twice, launch once!

introLines.speaker: Gordo
introLines.text: Shifting sand, tall mesas, deep tunnels. Gordo's boulder will shake those cliffs apart!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Bursts love open desert. Watch the wind, ride the gusts, and bonk every last bandit!

outroLines.speaker: Sultan Sandclaw
outroLines.text: My mesas… crumbled! The Queen of the thicket will tangle you in briars! Run, my bandits, run!

outroLines.speaker: Lulu
outroLines.text: Desert dusted! Next stop: the Thornwood Thicket. Mind the thorns, crew!

introLines.speaker: Poppy
introLines.text: Ooh, spooky! Twisted trees, glowing fireflies, and briars that grab your ankles. My kind of place!

introLines.speaker: Queen Briarfang
introLines.text: Trespassers in my thicket! My mimics stand among the vines — you will never tell rock from bandit!

introLines.speaker: Bongo
introLines.text: Aim for the dashers in the brush, crew. A bonked bandit is a beaten bandit!

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: Thorns or no thorns, Rocco's dive does not miss twice. Into the briars!

outroLines.speaker: Queen Briarfang
outroLines.text: My briar crown… snapped! The Overlord's foundry will forge your defeat in iron!

outroLines.speaker: Gordo
outroLines.text: Thicket thrashed! Iron walls next. Gordo loves iron walls. Gordo breaks iron walls.

introLines.speaker: Gordo
introLines.text: Steel plates, stone walls, furnace stacks! The Overlord built his vault out of solid iron!

introLines.speaker: Overlord Ironhide
introLines.text: My foundry forges the strongest forts in the realm. Your bananas are behind iron, monkeys — come and fail!

introLines.speaker: Zippy
introLines.text: Turbo bursts versus iron. Turbo wins. Aim for the weak joints and let the collapse do the rest!

introLines.speaker: Poppy
introLines.text: And if iron stops the siege… a split does not care about iron. Tee-hee!

outroLines.speaker: Overlord Ironhide
outroLines.text: Impossible! My iron… dented! The King himself guards the Golden Citadel. You will never breach it!

outroLines.speaker: Rocco
outroLines.text: One vault left — the big one! All monkeys, all powers, all heart!

introLines.speaker: King Goldentail
introLines.text: So the little monkeys reached my Citadel! Every banana in the realm sits in MY vault — and my whole royal guard stands before it!

introLines.speaker: Lulu
introLines.text: Golden towers, royal guards, the works. This is the last climb, crew — every trick we know!

introLines.speaker: Rocco
introLines.text: Crash dives, turbo bursts, triple splits, comeback curves, boulder drops, leaf glides — all seven of us, together. For the Great Banana Hoard!

introLines.speaker: Bongo
introLines.text: Places, everyone! The grand finale starts NOW!

outroLines.speaker: King Goldentail
outroLines.text: My golden crown… my vault… Take the hoard, you unstoppable monkeys. You earned every banana!

outroLines.speaker: Rocco
outroLines.text: THE GREAT BANANA HOARD IS OURS — ALL OF IT, FOREVER! Victory dance, everyone!

rivals.name: Nibbles
rivals.title: Rookie Flinger
taunts: Wait, which way do I pull the stretchy band again?!
Ooh, shiny banana! I meant to hit that cloud!
Aiming AND timing the power?! That is barely enough time to tie my laces!
rivals.defeatLine: Aww, my monkey got dizzy! Good game, show me how you aimed that!

rivals.name: Ziggy
rivals.title: Casual Slinger
taunts: Fast launch, faster bonks! Who needs a plan?
I don't wait for the perfect arc — I just launch and let the fort fall!
Watch Zippy go zoom across the fort!
rivals.defeatLine: Whoa, you chained those bonks together way cleaner than me!

rivals.name: Trixie
rivals.title: Trickster Ace
taunts: Why launch one monkey when Poppy gives you three?!
Sparkles, glass shatters, and triple bonks incoming!
Bet you can't beat my triple-split arc!
rivals.defeatLine: Okay, that trajectory was pure artistry! Rematch anytime!

rivals.name: Captain Coconut
rivals.title: Steady Veteran
taunts: Steady hand on the pouch, sharp eye on the wind!
No Bandit shelters safely when Bongo curves behind the wall!
Every barrel explosion is calculated to the centimeter, matey!
rivals.defeatLine: By the seven palms, your aim and timing are top-notch!

rivals.name: Professor Peel
rivals.title: Tactical Architect
taunts: According to my parabolic equations, this tower collapses in 1.4 seconds.
I never fall for a stray banana — observe the optimal collapse vector!
Structural weak point identified. Deploying Gordo's boulder drop!
rivals.defeatLine: Fascinating! Your empirical bonk efficiency exceeded my simulation!

rivals.name: Madame Mango
rivals.title: Grandmaster Slinger
taunts: Grace in the air, thunder in the collapse. Watch closely, darling.
Every shelter is merely an invitation for a chain bonk.
One collapse, darling, and the board is already clear.
rivals.defeatLine: Magnifique! Only a true master could outscore that turn!

rivals.name: Champ
rivals.title: Undisputed Jungle Legend
taunts: Zero wasted frames. Every shot lands, every collapse chains, every banana grabbed.
You reached the top of the ladder — now prove you can hold the crown!
Watch how a champion turns a steel fortress into a 5x combo!
rivals.defeatLine: Unbelievable! You out-slung the Champion, shot for shot! The crown is yours!

generators.notes: Seeded generation rules for the Daily Challenge and the Weekly Tournament. W-MODES implements generation from these params with mulberry32; no stored entries exist. Daily: seed = local calendar date as a YYYYMMDD integer; level = levels[seed mod 110]; one attempt per date, enforced in the save (date + score recorded). Tournament: seed = ISO calendar week as a YYYYWW integer; rivals and levels drawn by seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle; bracket quarterfinal, semifinal, final; trophy and title picked by seed mod list length. Rival scores: score = base + floor(spread * rng()) with rng seeded per rival per period.

tournament.rivalRule: seeded shuffle of all 7 rivals, take first 3 in order
tournament.levelRule: seeded shuffle of all 110 level indices, take first 3 in order (one per round)
tournament.elimination: single elimination; lose once and the run ends
tournament.leaderboardRule: seeded scores for all 7 rivals (daily table) plus the player row
tournament.rewardRule: trophy = trophies[seed mod 8]; title = titles[seed mod 8]

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: I count 5 Bandits in Ember Stair. Plenty of bonks to go around!

banter.speaker: Climber
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Ember Stair. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Cinder Arch is ours today. Load the sling, check the wind, and GO!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Cinder Arch. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Lava Rock Bunkers is ours today. Load the sling, check the wind, and GO!

banter.speaker: Digger
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Lava Rock Bunkers. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Scorched Bridge is ours today. Load the sling, check the wind, and GO!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Scorched Bridge. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: Basalt Bastion is ours today. Load the sling, check the wind, and GO!

banter.speaker: Climber
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Basalt Bastion. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Smoke Stack Run is ours today. Load the sling, check the wind, and GO!

banter.speaker: Digger
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Smoke Stack Run. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Obsidian Citadel! Climber is guarding this one — smash the glass and bonk fast!

banter.speaker: Climber
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Obsidian Citadel. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Volcano Gauntlet! Shielder is guarding this one — smash the stone and bonk fast!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Volcano Gauntlet. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Emperor Magma-Tail — BOSS FINALE! Big Boss is guarding this one — smash the stone and bonk fast!

banter.speaker: Emperor Magma-Tail
banter.line: Boss says no monkey gets past Emperor Magma-Tail — BOSS FINALE. Boss is always right!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: First frozen fort! Rocco dives straight through the ice!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Cold stone, warm bananas! This fort copies nobody's mercy!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: High perches? Lulu flies! Watch the ice ledges below!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Fly all you want! My shield is colder than this mountain!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Dashers in the aurora light! Bongo's curve comes back for them all!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Pretty lights, pretty traps! I mimic every monkey I meet!

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Deep snow, thick walls! Gordo's boulder cracks them open!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Shake the mountain! My shield never slips!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Crystal walls guard the mimics! Zippy's burst smashes through them all!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Crystal clear: I look just like your friend! Guess wrong!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Blizzard walls? Poppy splits three ways and smashes through! Tee-hee!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Three monkeys cannot bonk what shields cannot see! ...Can they?

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: Tall tower, cold wind! Dive steep, aim true!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Six stories of frost! Every floor guards one more of me!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: A maze of ice! Lulu flies over every wall!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Maze walls, maze shields! Getting lost yet, flyer?

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Six bandits, one vault! Curve around the back, bonk the rest!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The vault is sealed! The vault is me! The vault is both!

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Marquis Frostwhisker! Gordo's boulder breaks ice crowns!

banter.speaker: Marquis Frostwhisker
banter.line: My glacier, my bananas, my rules! Freeze, monkeys!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Dust devils everywhere! Zippy's burst rides the wind!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Sand in your eyes? Good! I look like everyone out here!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Mesa walls so tall! Poppy splits over them all!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Tricksters hate the desert sun! My shield loves it!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Cactus spikes below, open sky above! Lulu flies!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Watch the spines! I am the cactus! I am the monkey!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Sunbaked and stubborn! Curve around and smash them all!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Baked hard as mesa stone! Monkeys just bounce off!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: Sand in the eyes, stone in the way! Rocco dives true!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The storm guards us all! Which shadow is real?

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Cliff vaults shake when Gordo's boulder drops! Smash time!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Shake the cliff! My shield is bolted to the rock!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Mirages and mimics! Poppy's split sees through tricks!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Is this fort real? Am I real? Are YOU real?

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Ridge runners! Lulu flies the whole ridge in one glide!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Ridge shields! Ridge spikes! Ridge everything!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Six guards on the dunes! Bursts for all of them!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Dunes shift! I shift! Nothing here stays still!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: Sultan Sandclaw! Your desert days are done!

banter.speaker: Sultan Sandclaw
banter.line: The desert keeps what it buries! Bananas included!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Thorns everywhere! Smash first, ask questions never!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The thicket grows mimics like berries! Pick one!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Vines grab, thorns snag — Poppy splits right through all of it!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Vines hold my shield steady! Try bonking THAT!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Fireflies light the way! Lulu flies the hollow by glow!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Glow little firefly, glow! Which light is me?

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Roots twist, branches break! Nothing here can hold Poppy!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Rooted like an old oak! My shield grows here!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Labyrinth walls? Zippy's turbo burst needs no map!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Every turn, another me! The maze is my mirror!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: A bigboss in the grove! Poppy splits straight for the trunk!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The grove grew a champion! Guess which one is the tree!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Brambles below, bigboss ahead! Lulu flies the whole keep!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Bramble shields! Thorn shields! Shield shields!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: The canopy whispers! Curve around back, bonk the guards!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Whisper, whisper... every leaf is watching you!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: The vault's heart beats in the briars! Poppy splits to find it!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: The heart is shielded! The shield is hearted!

banter.speaker: Gordo
banter.line: Queen Briarfang! Gordo's boulder drops shake the whole thicket!

banter.speaker: Queen Briarfang
banter.line: My thorns drink monkey tears! Come closer, little apes!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Iron walls, steel beams! Zippy's turbo burst punches through all of it!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Steel mimics! Iron mimics! Clang, clang, guess again!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Furnaces roar, Poppy splits! Three monkeys past the fire!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Forged in furnace fire! My shield is fresh from the anvil!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Steel ramparts, furnace winds! Lulu rides the heat up and over!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Hot metal, cold tricks! I am the rampart now!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Smoke stacks guard the runners! Curve around and bonk them in the haze!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Smoke and steel! My shield smells like the forge!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: Anvils ring, Rocco dives! Straight down through the sparks!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Hammer, anvil, mimic! Three of us, one of you!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Slag pits bubble below! Poppy splits above them all!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Slag-proof shields! Lava-proof shields! Monkey-proof shields!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: Gears turn, Lulu flies! Three seconds over the whole bastion!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Tick, tock, mimic! The gears count your last shots!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Molten causeway, narrow path! Curve around and bonk them from behind!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: The causeway is mine! The molten rock is mine!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: The Ironhold vault gleams! Poppy splits past every guard!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Vault doors, vault mimics! Open the wrong one, monkey!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Overlord! Zippy's turbo burst cracks the thickest iron!

banter.speaker: Overlord Ironhide
banter.line: I am the forge! I am the furnace! You are SCRAP!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: The Golden Gate shines! Lulu flies straight into the vault!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Gold mimics! Royal mimics! Bow before your better!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Royal ramparts, golden guards! Poppy splits, then bonks!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: The King's shield! The King's gold! The King's NO!

banter.speaker: Bongo
banter.line: Crown jewels everywhere! Curve around back, pocket nothing — bonk all!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Jewels, jewels! I am the shiniest jewel of all!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Only three monkeys now! Poppy's split makes every shot count three times!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Three monkeys, six guards! The math is golden!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: The throne room steps climb high! Lulu flies them all!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The throne is mine! The steps are mine! The crown is mine!

banter.speaker: Zippy
banter.line: Crowns piled high! Zippy's turbo burst knocks the whole vault down!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Crown shields! Royal steel! Kneel, monkey!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: Stars fall, Poppy splits! Three monkeys over the whole terrace!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: Starlight shows every trick! ...Except mine!

banter.speaker: Lulu
banter.line: The Royal Guard stands tall! Lulu flies over every last one!

banter.speaker: Shielder
banter.line: Guard the King! Guard the gold! Guard the door!

banter.speaker: Poppy
banter.line: The spire touches the stars! Poppy splits and climbs the sky itself!

banter.speaker: Mimic
banter.line: The spire's top is mine! The sky is mine! Everything is mine!

banter.speaker: Rocco
banter.line: King Goldentail! Two bigbosses, four monkeys, one grand finale!

banter.speaker: King Goldentail
banter.line: My royal guard! My golden vault! Monkeys, you shall NOT pass!
